_real_world.class: Dedicated electronic-attack variant of the J-15 carrier fighter, analogous in role to the USN EA-18G Growler
_real_world.variant_scope: J-15D EW suite: wingtip ESM/ECM pods (replacing the baseline J-15's wingtip missile rails), plus a fuselage jammer/countermeasures fit
public_equipment: Wingtip ESM/ECM pods replacing wingtip AAM rails (TWZ, B); described as China's first dedicated carrier-based electronic-attack aircraft, EA-18G-analogous role (TWZ, Naval News); no jammer power, bandwidth, or RWR sensitivity figures publicly disclosed

_provenance.modeling_note: EW suite for J-15D per the task's requirement (jammer pods/ESM). TWZ and Naval News (Tier B) confirm the J-15D's role as a dedicated carrier electronic-attack aircraft comparable to the EA-18G Growler, with wingtip ESM/ECM pods replacing the baseline J-15's wingtip AAM rails. No PRC disclosure of jammer power, bandwidth, RWR sensitivity, or countermeasures loadout exists. All numeric fields are engineering_estimate proxies patterned on the repo CSG_US_ALQ-99 (Growler-analogous jammer pod) where present in the database, or on the repo CSG_US_ALQ-214_ALR-67 (self-protection EW suite template read this session) scaled upward to reflect the J-15D's dedicated stand-off/escort-jamming role rather than pure self-protection, since no J-15D-specific figures exist. jammer.type is set to DeceptionDRFM reflecting modern EW-suite convention for a dedicated jamming aircraft (vs a simpler self-protection noise jammer), consistent with the EA-18G-analogous role attributed by TWZ/Naval News.

rwr.sensitivity_dbm.note: proxy copied from the repo CSG_US_ALQ-214_ALR-67 record; no public figure

jammer.power_watts.note: engineering_estimate scaled upward from a pure self-protection jammer template to reflect the J-15D's dedicated stand-off/escort-jamming role (EA-18G-analogous per TWZ/Naval News); no public power figure exists

jammer.bandwidth_mhz.note: engineering_estimate consistent with a wideband dedicated jamming pod; no public figure

jammer.type.note: DeceptionDRFM: chosen to reflect a modern dedicated electronic-attack role (TWZ/Naval News's EA-18G-analogous characterization) rather than a simple self-protection noise jammer; no public confirmation of the specific jamming technique

jammer.effective_angle.note: engineering_estimate reflecting wingtip-pod placement (TWZ) giving wide-angle coverage; no public figure

jammer.is_active.note: true: a dedicated electronic-attack aircraft's jammer defaults to active; standard convention

countermeasures.chaff_count.note: proxy consistent with the repo CSG_US_ALQ-214_ALR-67 pattern for a carrier fighter-size airframe; no public figure

countermeasures.flare_count.note: proxy consistent with the repo CSG_US_ALQ-214_ALR-67 pattern; no public figure

countermeasures.release_interval.note: proxy copied from the repo CSG_US_ALQ-214_ALR-67 pattern; no public figure

countermeasures.auto_mode.note: true: standard convention, copied from the repo CSG_US_ALQ-214_ALR-67 pattern
